<?php
class AssertionsStringOption104 {
    public string $id; public string $option;
    public function __construct($id,$option) {$this->id=$id;$this->option=$option;}
    public function __toString():string {echo "T:",$this->id,":",$GLOBALS["stage"],";";return $this->option;}
    public function __destruct() {echo "D:",$this->id,":",ini_get("zend.assertions"),";";}
}
class AssertionsStringTemporary104 implements Iterator {
    public int $pos=0; public AssertionsStringOption104 $name;
    public function __construct() {$this->name=new AssertionsStringOption104("A","zend.assertions");}
    public function rewind():void {echo "W;";$this->pos=0;}
    public function valid():bool {echo "V",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos<2;}
    public function current():mixed {echo "C",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos===0?$this->name:" 0x2 ";}
    public function key():mixed {echo "K",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos;}
    public function next():void {echo "N",$this->pos,";";$this->pos++;if($this->pos===2){$GLOBALS["stage"]="done";}}
    public function __destruct() {echo "I:",ini_get("zend.assertions"),";";}
}
function makeString104() {$it=new AssertionsStringTemporary104;$GLOBALS["watch"]=WeakReference::create($it);return $it;}
$stage="walk";$watch=null;echo "B;";
$result=ini_set(...makeString104());echo "R:",$result,":",ini_get("zend.assertions"),":",($watch->get()===null?1:0),";";
unset($watch);ini_restore("zend.assertions");echo "E:",ini_get("zend.assertions"),";";
purpose: A copied string with whitespace and a hexadecimal prefix retains exact raw INI bytes while setting the parsed nonnegative assertion quantity; option and Iterator retire before the write, then restore returns startup 1.

<?php
class AssertionsStringSelectedOption104 {
    public string $id; public string $option;
    public function __construct($id,$option) {$this->id=$id;$this->option=$option;}
    public function __toString():string {echo "T:",$this->id,":",$GLOBALS["stage"],";";return $this->option;}
    public function __destruct() {echo "D:",$this->id,":",ini_get("zend.assertions"),";";}
}
class AssertionsStringValues104 implements Iterator {
    public int $pos=0;
    public function rewind():void {echo "W;";$this->pos=0;}
    public function valid():bool {echo "V",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos<2;}
    public function current():mixed {echo "C",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos===0?$GLOBALS["name"]:"0";}
    public function key():mixed {echo "K",$this->pos,";";if($this->pos===0){$GLOBALS["name"]=new AssertionsStringSelectedOption104("B","display_errors");$GLOBALS["call"]=ini_get(...);}return $this->pos;}
    public function next():void {echo "N",$this->pos,";";$this->pos++;if($this->pos===2){$GLOBALS["stage"]="done";}}
}
$stage="walk";$name=new AssertionsStringSelectedOption104("A","zend.assertions");$it=new AssertionsStringValues104;$call=ini_set(...);$keep=$call;echo "B;";
$result=$call(...$it);echo "R:",$result,":",ini_get("zend.assertions"),":",$name->id,":",$call("zend.assertions"),":",$keep("zend.assertions","2"),":",ini_get("zend.assertions"),";";
unset($it,$name,$call,$keep);ini_restore("zend.assertions");echo "E:",ini_get("zend.assertions"),";";
purpose: Copied decimal string 0 sets quantity 0; the selected first-class setter survives key-time option and callable rebinding, then a retained string setting 2 updates before restore.
